menu.title: Anatolia B.I.S.
menu.guideContent:
SIGN IN
Sign in with your user code and password.

REGISTRATION
Submit a request with your first name, last name, email, and a user code. Your request goes to an administrator for approval — you cannot sign in until it is approved.

WAITING FOR APPROVAL
After registering, the app automatically checks whether your account has been approved.
menu.aboutContent:
Anatolia B.I.S. is a biometric candidate-matching and identity verification platform developed by Bold Askeri Teknoloji ve Savunma Sanayi A.Ş. for authorized institutions. The system is built around human-reviewed candidate matches, not automated identity decisions.

Project code: BIS 200120401018
menu.missionContent:
MISSION
Provide authorized institutions with a reliable, auditable, privacy-first biometric verification infrastructure.

VISION
Become the institutional standard for verification systems that leave decisions to people, not algorithms, and record every action.
